header: Reduce the size of bulk request responses
content:
To reduce the size of OpenSearch responses, exclude unnecessary ﬁelds with the filter_path
parameter. Make sure that you don't ﬁlter out any ﬁelds that are required to identify or retry failed
requests. For more information and examples, see the section called “Reducing response size”.
